title: Mordecai is promoted and Esther's plea to revoke the decree
description: After Haman's death, King Ahasuerus gives Haman's house to Esther and the signet ring to Mordecai. Esther falls weeping before the king and asks him to revoke the decree to destroy the Jews. The king extends the golden scepter and grants Esther and Mordecai authority to write new edicts in the king's name, sealed with the signet ring [ref:Ester 8:1-8|Ester 8:1-8].
